head.text: WF-042 Error counters and the change from error active to error passive

foot.text: Events, not bits. A receiver error adds 1 to REC, an error of the transmitter adds 8 to TEC, a successful frame subtracts 1. The transmit error counter reaching 128 makes the node error passive; the error that causes it still gets an active error flag, the next error flag is 6 recessive bits and it waits 8 bit times after the intermission before it sends again (REF-001 section 7).
